# agentic-persona

Keep one consistent AI persona across social content.

Keywords: persona,influencer,brand-voice,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-persona".
- CLI: agentic-persona summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-persona mcp, then call summarize_text.
